_readme: Model Context Protocol servers for the LMM Engine teammate, checked against vendor documentation on 2026-10-20.

mcpServers: local servers. Copy the entries you need into claude_desktop_config.json (Claude Desktop: Settings, Developer, Edit Config) or into .mcp.json for Claude Code, replace every REPLACE_WITH value, and restart.

remoteConnectors: vendor-hosted servers. These are not added through the config file: in Claude, open Settings, Connectors, Add custom connector, paste the URL and sign in. Many are already in Claude's connector directory; prefer the directory listing where it exists.
Secrets: keep keys out of this repository. Give every server the narrowest key it needs, read-only where the vendor offers it.
The teammate itself never writes to a platform. Platform writes, when you ask Claude for them, happen through these servers with your approval of each change.

remoteConnectors.name: HubSpot
remoteConnectors.use: contacts, companies, lists, workflows and email performance; property writes with approval

remoteConnectors.name: Klaviyo (remote)
remoteConnectors.use: the hosted alternative to the local klaviyo server above; use one, not both

remoteConnectors.name: Braze
remoteConnectors.use: Canvases, campaigns, segments and performance; the earlier local Braze server is deprecated

remoteConnectors.name: Customer.io
remoteConnectors.use: campaigns, segments, people and message metrics

remoteConnectors.name: BigQuery (Google managed)
remoteConnectors.use: run the cohort and audit queries against the warehouse; the local bigquery server above is the alternative

remoteConnectors.name: Snowflake (Snowflake managed)
remoteConnectors.auth: Snowflake OAuth or a programmatic access token
remoteConnectors.use: run the cohort and audit queries; create the server first with CREATE MCP SERVER. Snowflake-Labs/mcp is deprecated

remoteConnectors.name: Google Sheets (developer preview)
remoteConnectors.auth: Google OAuth with your own OAuth client; enable sheetsmcp.googleapis.com; Claude's redirect URI is https://claude.ai/api/mcp/auth_callback
remoteConnectors.use: read the reporting sheet that adapters/destinations/sheets.py writes

noOfficialServer.Salesforce Marketing Cloud: no vendor MCP server found; paste exports, or go through the warehouse (CONNECTORS.md)
noOfficialServer.Segment and RudderStack: send events to adapters/sources/webhooks.py or sync them to the warehouse
noOfficialServer.Google Analytics 4: export to BigQuery and use the BigQuery server, or forward Measurement Protocol events to adapters/sources/webhooks.py
